top_signals.title: Operating Without People at Sea Doesn’t Mean Operating Without People
top_signals.summary: Autonomy is often described as removing people from operations. That’s not quite right.It’s not a case of people ‘simply’ being replaced by machines. It’s about the move from vessel-centered operations to shore-enabled operations. People still matter…
